candidates.description: This vector represents various conjugated forms and tenses of the French verb "être" (to be).
This vector is related to quotation marks and punctuation used for dialogue or citations.
This vector represents units of time and calendar periods across multiple languages.
This vector represents French personal pronouns and subject words referring to people or entities.
This vector represents common French grammatical words, pronouns, and articles.
This vector represents a diverse collection of East Asian characters and letters from multiple writing systems including Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
This vector represents words or abbreviations related to holiness, saintly titles, and religious figures across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents closing punctuation marks, often combined with quotation marks and spacing in text formatting.
These tokens represent Roman numerals used for numbering, sequencing, or royal and generational titles.
This vector represents common word-initial or clitic consonant-vowel fragments, frequently found at the beginning of French pronouns, articles, and short nouns.
